releases.title: 13 more videos
new: 13 more lesson slots now have a video, after a second search that also checked each video's transcript: webhooks at scale (Stripe Developers), temperature and top-p, building tools for agents, OWASP Excessive Agency, CODEOWNERS and branch rules, permission-aware RAG, contextual retrieval, LLM-as-a-judge, single vs multi-agent systems, showing uncertainty to users, and three enterprise-AI talks in Week 0C.
changed: The 22 remaining slots keep their doc on purpose: no video checked out as accurate and current for them (for example GitHub and Zendesk API details, the newest Claude API behavior, and Lilian Weng's agents post).

affects.note: Day 3 Enterprise now has webhook videos.
Day 3 Enterprise has a permission-aware RAG video.
Day 1 has a single vs multi-agent video.
Day 3 Enterprise has a video on showing uncertainty.

releases.title: Videos in every lesson
new: In Weeks 0A–5, most reading items are now short YouTube videos (about 100 picks from channels like Anthropic, LangChain, 3Blue1Brown, Andrej Karpathy, IBM Technology and Corey Schafer). Each card shows the length, the exact part to watch when only part of a long video matters, and what to look for. The docs are still there under "Reference (optional)".
changed: Lessons: each doc that a video replaces now sits under "Reference (optional)", so you can still check exact API details while coding.

affects.note: Readings in Weeks 0A–5 became videos. If you already read a doc for a day, you don't need to watch its video.

releases.title: Week 5 published, and the platform now updates itself
new: Week 5: Conversational & Multimodal Agents. Build P4, a voice and photo auto-parts ordering assistant with a local voice pipeline, photos matched to a catalog, a read-back the customer confirms, and risk-gated human approval.
Automatic updates: the start script now checks for updates when it starts and once a day while it runs. Your own work in code/ is never touched.
This "What's new" window and a full history on the What's new page.
changed: Practice: two certification questions updated for the current Claude API (forced tool_choice and what strict schemas guarantee), and two explanations expanded.
Plan: Week 5 links and tools now point to the free, local voice and vision stack.

affects.note: Questions c-d2-05 and c-d4-04 changed. If you answered them before, try them again.

releases.title: Week 4 published, plus improvements to Weeks 0B–3
new: Week 4: Multi-Agent Systems. Build P3, a multi-agent EV road-trip planner with LangGraph, parallel sub-agents, human approval and evals.
A coding gym with two timed, interview-style problems at the end of Weeks 1–4.
Week 3: a new Day 3 section, "Rewriting the question" (Exercise 3b and a mini-quiz), a "When vector RAG isn't the answer" card, and an API + Streamlit add-on in Weekend 1.
Week 2: a "How to choose an embedding model" card after Day 3.
Plan: a PyTorch primer before fine-tuning in Week 9.
changed: Week 0B: the Enterprise track is now "Enterprise APIs in Python" (API docs, pagination, webhooks, idempotency keys, incremental sync). TypeScript moves to an optional Bonus module.
Week 1: Enterprise days 1–4 are now "Working on a team's codebase" (small PRs, reviewing agent code, CI, lint and branch protection).
Quizzes: a few questions replaced in Weeks 0B and 1 to match the new Enterprise content.
Week 3: Interview room question 1 replaced and a new question 8 (graph vs vector retrieval).
Plan: Weeks 5, 7, 8, 16 and 20 now say how they build on Weeks 3–4.
fixed: Long quiz answers now wrap on small screens instead of running off the side.

affects.note: Enterprise track replaced, and quiz questions D1–D3 h4 and weekly w12 changed. Retake those if you already finished them.
